waypoint-beacon.name: Waypoint Beacon
waypoint-beacon.scan: Federation navigation beacon. Broadcasting standard relay traffic. No life signs beyond automated systems.
waypoint-beacon.hail: Waypoint Beacon acknowledges. Safe travels, Meridian. Relay logs are clear.

tarsus-iii.name: Tarsus III
tarsus-iii.scan: Class-M world. Liquid water oceans, temperate bands, dense vegetation. No industrial emissions. No artificial signals. This world is unclaimed.

tarsus-iv.name: Tarsus IV
tarsus-iv.scan: Class-K world. Surface temperature exceeds 460 kelvin. Crushing atmosphere. Not survivable without full environmental suits.

erebus-i.name: Erebus I
erebus-i.scan: Airless rock, tidally locked to its red dwarf. Rich mineral signatures in the crust — dilithium traces detected. No life.

the-drifter.name: SS Vanadis (derelict)
the-drifter.scan: Civilian transport, registry predates current Federation records. Hull cold. Minimal power on an emergency circuit. One faint life-sign reading — intermittent. No response to standard hails.

vela-prime.name: Vela Prime
vela-prime.scan: Class-M world with active radio emissions in the 2 GHz band — structured, non-random. Something down there is broadcasting. Pattern does not match any known Federation language.
vela-prime.hail: [UNIVERSAL TRANSLATOR: unable to resolve. Signal is language-like but unmatched. Establishing contact will require patience.]

vela-b.name: Vela B
vela-b.scan: Gas giant. Violent storm systems. Sixteen moons, three large enough to hold atmosphere. Not a candidate for landing.
